\bHi! Is it your first time here at the Safari Zone?
\bThe Safari Zone actually has\nfour zones in it.
\bEach zone has different kinds of Pokémon, even some rare ones.
\bUse the supplied Safari Balls to catch them.
\bYou can also throw Bait or Rocks besides the Safari Balls.
\bIf you throw Bait, the Pokémon becomes less likely to flee, but harder to catch.
\bIf you throw Rocks, the Pokémon becomes more likely to flee, but easier to catch.
\bWhen you run out of time or Safari Balls, it's game over for you!
